ja481:1.1: Aham eva dubbhāsitaṃ bhāsi bālo bheko v' araññe ahim avhayāno, Takkāriye sobbham imaṃ patāmi, na kir' eva sādhu ativelabhāṇīti.
ja481:2.1: Pappoti macco ativelabhāṇī evaṃ vadhaṃ sokapariddavañ ca, attānaṃ yeva garahāsi ettha ācera yan taṃ nikhaṇanti sobbhe ti.
ja481:3.1: Kim ev' ahaṃ Tuṇḍilam ānupuccheyyaṃ Kareyya saṃ bhātaraṃ Kālikā yaṃ, naggo v' ahaṃ vatthayugañ ca jīno, ayam pi attho bahu tādiso vā 'ti.
ja481:4.1: Yo yujjhamānānaṃ ayujjhamāno meṇḍantaraṃ accupatī kuliṃko so piṃsito meṇḍasirehi tattha, ayam pi attho bahu tādiso vā 'ti.
ja481:5.1: Caturo janā potthakaṃ aggahesuṃ, ekañ ca posaṃ anurakkhamānā sabbe va te bhinnasirā sayiṃsu, ayam pi attho bahu tādiso vā 'ti.
ja481:6.1: Ajā yathā veḷugumbasmiṃ baddhā avekkhipantī asik' ajjhagañchi ten' eva tassā galak' āvakantaṃ, ayam pi attho bahu tādiso vā 'ti. Na-y-ime
ja481:7.1: devā na pi gandhabbaputtā, migā ime atthavasābhatā ime, ekañ ca naṃ sāyamāse pacantu ekañ ca naṃ pātarāse pacantū 'ti.
ja481:8.1: Sataṃ sahassaṃ dubbhāsitānaṃ kalam pi nāgghanti subhāsitassa, dubbhāsitaṃ saṃkamāno kileso, tasmā tuṇhī kimpurisā, na balyā ti.
ja481:9.1: Yā mesā vyāhāsi pamuñcath' etaṃ, giriñ ca naṃ Himavantaṃ nayantu, imañ ca kho dentu mahānasāya pāto ca naṃ pātarāse pacantū 'ti.
ja481:10.1: Pajjunnanāthā pasavo, pasunāthā ayaṃ pajā, tvaṃnātho 'smi mahārāja, nātho 'haṃ bhariyāya ca, dvinnam aññataraṃ ñatvā mutto gaccheyya pabbatan ti.
ja481:11.1: Na ve nindā suparivajjayā ce nānā janā sevitabbā janinda, yen' eva eko labhate pasaṃsaṃ ten' eva añño labhate ninditāraṃ.
ja481:12.1: Sabbo loko paracitto acitto, sabbo loko cittavasamhi citto, paccekacittā puthu sabbasattā, kass' īdha cittassa vase na vatte
ja481:13.1: ti. Tuṇhī ahū kimpuriso sabhariyo, yo dāni vyāhāsi bhayassa bhīto so dāni mutto sukhito arogo, vācā kir' ev' atthavatī narānan ti.
